notes: The dog now shows its working, and you get a hand in it. A local ledger records every delegated sub-agent: the console Stream view grows a FLEETS board with each clone's status, its role, the complexity band the split was judged by, and the exact token facts (an unknown number is shown as unknown, never as a guess). The receipt that tells the owner how the work was split is system-generated, so the model cannot quietly forget to mention it. A deterministic, zero-token complexity band decides whether a request is broad enough to warrant several clones, and an owner setting decides how far that band may act - it reports by default and only refuses a split when you ask it to. Four roles (scout, analyst, implementer, verifier) give each clone a fixed tool policy, an iteration bound and a fixed report block, so the parent folds reports instead of transcripts; a role is opt-in and can only narrow the tools it was given. A fleet that may write waits for you: the refusal names a plan id, you approve it in a new console card, and one approval authorizes exactly one dispatch. The journey card now offers three starter scenes that only prefill the chat box - nothing is sent for you - the Memory Core card opens a read-only, searchable view of what the product actually remembers, and the site answers the question the install section left open: what can you do right after installing. Nothing new was uploaded, no new credential exists, and the only outbound path is the one you already know.
